cards.t: DTCC Plans Solana Integration for Tokenized Assets in 2027
cards.b: The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) plans to expand its Wall Street tokenization roadmap to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs, and U.S. Treasuries to the Solana blockchain by 2027.

per.SOL: Integration into DTCC's traditional finance settlement network expands institutional utility and scale.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Interim rollout milestones before the 2027 launch.

cards.t: Upbit and Bithumb List SANC Token
cards.b: Upbit has announced plans to list the SANC token, opening trading pairs against the South Korean Won, Bitcoin, and USDT, with Bithumb also scheduling a new listing.

per.SANC: Upbit and Bithumb listings with multiple major trading pairs are driving heightened market activity and price appreciation.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact launch timestamps for the trading pairs opening.

cards.t: Winklevoss Files for Spot Zcash ETF
cards.b: Winklevoss has filed for a spot Zcash ETF featuring a $100 million indication of interest.

per.ZEC: Filing for a spot ETF with strong initial financial backing provides a major catalyst for token demand.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Regulatory review timelines and approval status.

cards.t: Strategy and Metaplanet Face MSCI Index Removal
cards.b: MSCI confirmed that Strategy and Metaplanet will be removed from its stock indexes on November 30, triggering stock drops and adding pressure to Bitcoin holdings.

per.BTC: Index removal for major corporate holders could affect treasury strategies and market sentiment.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Long-term impact on corporate Bitcoin accumulation plans.

cards.t: Bybit Lists OROCHI and IDOL Perpetual Contracts
cards.b: Bybit is expanding its derivatives offerings by listing perpetual contracts for Orochi Network (OROCHI) and MEET48 (IDOL).

per.OROCHI: Perpetual contract listing on Bybit expands market access and leverage options.
per.IDOL: Perpetual contract listing on Bybit increases liquidity and trading accessibility.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact date and time for when trading goes live.

cards.b: Coinbase has announced plans to launch a PEARL-USD spot market in supported regions.

per.PEARL: A spot listing on Coinbase opens access to broader retail and institutional liquidity.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Launch date and exact rollout times.

cards.t: DOJ Seizes $1.2B from Binance Hack and Dismantles FaceStealer Scam
cards.b: The U.S. Department of Justice received court approval to seize $1.2 billion in stolen crypto from the historic Binance hack and shut down the FaceStealer deepfake scam infrastructure.

per.BNB: Regulatory crackdowns on legacy exploits highlight ongoing security sweeps across major ecosystems.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Timeline for asset distribution back to affected parties.

cards.t: BTCS Sells Ether to Maintain Aave Loan Health
cards.b: Nasdaq-listed Ethereum treasury firm BTCS has sold ether at a loss to protect a $64 million Aave loan from liquidation risks as prices slide.

per.ETH: Distressed treasury liquidations increase selling pressure on the asset.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact amount of ETH sold and current precise health factor of the remaining loan.
